title: Rasm Page Banners (Desktop 21:9 & Mobile 1:1)

fields.label: Desktop Banner Image (21:9 Aspect Ratio)
fields.name: desktop_banner
fields.instructions: Ultra-widescreen landscape banner for desktop devices (21:9 aspect ratio, recommended 2100 x 900 px). Upload clean photographs without baked-in text.

fields.label: Mobile Banner Image (1:1 Square Aspect Ratio)
fields.name: mobile_banner
fields.instructions: Square banner for smartphones and mobile devices (1:1 aspect ratio, recommended 1080 x 1080 px). If left empty, the desktop banner will be cropped to square.

fields.label: Banner Alt Text (SEO & Accessibility)
fields.name: banner_alt
fields.instructions: Short descriptive sentence for search engines, e.g., 'Royal wedding mandap at Umaid Bhawan Palace in Jodhpur'.

description: Upload custom 21:9 desktop and 1:1 mobile banners for Homepage, Destination pages, and Service pages.
